# yandex-search-cli

> CLI for Yandex Search API and YandexGPT. Provides structured web search, image search, reverse image search, generative search, and Wordstat query-frequency statistics from terminal with JSON output for scripts, developers, and AI agents.

## Install

```bash
uv tool install yandex-search-cli
```

or:

```bash
pip install yandex-search-cli
```

## Setup

Option 1 (recommended):

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.search-api
echo '{"apiKey": "your-key", "folderId": "your-folder-id"}' > ~/.search-api/config.json
```

Option 2 (env vars):

```bash
export YANDEX_API_KEY=your-key
export YANDEX_FOLDER_ID=your-folder-id
```

Requires a Yandex Cloud account with Search API enabled: https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/search-api/quickstart

## Commands

- `yandex-search <query>` — structured Yandex web search from terminal. Flags: --json, --num-results, --type (ru|com|tr|kk|be|uz), --region, --page, --site
- `yandex-gen <query>` — YandexGPT answer generation with search context. Flags: --json, --site
- `yandex-image-search <query>` — image search by text query. Flags: --json, --num-results, --type, --region, --page, --site
- `yandex-image-search-by-image (--url URL | --cbir-id ID)` — reverse image search, find pages containing a given image. Flags: --site, --page, --family-mode (none|moderate|strict), --json
- `yandex-wordstat <top|dynamics|regions|regions-tree>` — Yandex Wordstat query-frequency statistics. `top <phrase>`: most popular queries; `dynamics <phrase> --from DATE`: frequency over time; `regions <phrase>`: geographic distribution; `regions-tree`: supported region IDs

## Best for

- Russian-language search
- AI agents
- terminal automation
- JSON output
- developer productivity
- image search and reverse image search
- keyword research / SEO query-frequency data (Wordstat)

## JSON output

yandex-search returns: [{title, url, domain, date, passages[]}]
yandex-gen returns: {message{content, role}, sources[{used, title, url}], isAnswerRejected, fixedMisspellQuery}
yandex-image-search returns: [{url, domain, title, thumbnail_url, width, height, page_url, format}]
yandex-image-search-by-image returns: {images[{url, format, width, height, passage, host, pageTitle, pageUrl}], page, id}
yandex-wordstat top returns: {totalCount, results[{phrase, count}], associations[{phrase, count}]}
yandex-wordstat dynamics returns: {results[{date, count, share}]}
yandex-wordstat regions returns: {results[{region, count, share, affinityIndex}]}
yandex-wordstat regions-tree returns: {regions[{id, label, children[]}]}

## Quick examples

```bash
yandex-search "smart city digital platform" --json
yandex-search "query" --site habr.com --json
yandex-gen "explain microservices vs monolith" --json
yandex-search "query" --json | jq -r '.[].url'
yandex-image-search "python logo" --json
yandex-image-search-by-image --url "https://example.com/photo.jpg" --json
yandex-wordstat top "python framework" -n 20 --json
yandex-wordstat dynamics "python framework" --period monthly --from 2026-01-01 --json
```

## Key files

- `README.md`: English overview, install, quickstart
- `README.ru.md`: Russian overview and examples
- `AGENTS.md`: instructions for AI coding agents
- `docs/USAGE.md`: full usage guide
- `src/yandex_cli/client.py`: YandexSearchClient request/response contract layer
- `src/yandex_cli/parsers.py`: web/image XML rawData parsers
- `pyproject.toml`: package metadata and CLI entry points
